column13: Custom vented hood and large rear wing.
column17: Former member of THE 4 DEVILS (Raven Blood)

column3: エキゾースト イヴ
column11: A quiet, unassuming office lady by day. Yet beneath the pale light of a full moon, her hidden, merciless alter ego 'Eve' awakens to dominate the asphalt.
column17: Former member of THE 4 DEVILS (Exhaust Eve)

column11: Appeared like a blazing purple comet, overthrowing the Four Devas and Four Devils to reign supreme over the Shuto. Every driver on the road instantly feels his suffocating, regal aura.
column17: Usurper of the Four Devas and Four Devils

column11: Commands a pure-white chassis at mind-bending velocity. Rumor holds that across the entire underground scene, not a single racer has ever witnessed his car from the front.
column13: Custom vented hood and large rear wing.

column11: A legendary entity shrouded in absolute mystery. Whispered about in hushed rumors for years, no one has ever met him. It is said he materializes only when a kindred spirit takes to the asphalt.
A brilliant natural talent driven by a reckless kamikaze spirit, balanced by an affable, easygoing nature. Dancing on the razor's edge of total destruction, he has written off countless machines.
Made his name in his bachelor days with wild, life-threatening aggression. After marriage and fatherhood, his craft evolved into a pursuit of clinical safety and exquisite technical perfection.
A skilled home garage tuner who shares his detailed build specs on his personal website. Because his driving is ordinary, traffic is low, prompting him to print domain decals to hand out.

column3: スピード ドランカー
column11: A rollercoaster-addicted nurse who fell in love with speed and crossed over into street racing. She is hopelessly infatuated with 'Servant of Darkness' who runs the loop.
A battle-hardened veteran who served in foreign mercenary legions until a few years ago. His current street moniker is taken directly from the final combat operation in which he saw action.
A fiercely solitary wolf who refuses to run with a pack, pounding the asphalt alone. Rumored to be painfully shy, catching a glimpse of him out on the road requires miraculous luck.
Obsessed with the number '3,' he runs exclusively on the outer loop. He downs concentrated espresso before each battle to heighten focus, though his peak concentration lasts only three minutes.
A ghostly racer who materializes on the loop without warning and vanishes in a heartbeat. Very few competitors have ever managed to keep eyes on his machine until the battle's end.

column3: マシン オブ インフェルノ
column11: Keeps a level head during close dogfights and races clean; but the moment a rival opens up a gap, he snaps into a blind rage, resorting to any dirty trick to claw his way back.
Deeply tormented by how his personality violently warps whenever his hands grip the steering wheel, yet powerless to stop himself from heading out the moment night falls.
Third son of a prosperous dentist. Relies on wealthy girlfriends to bankroll his chassis modifications; while he favors aggressive acceleration setups, his backbone under pressure is nonexistent.
Renowned not only for his silky car handling but as a legendary pickup artist across Tokyo. He currently pens a serialized lifestyle column for a leading men's fashion publication.
A mysterious figure who allegedly survived in deep jungle wilderness for two solid years. Blessed with predatory eyesight, his fatal flaw is an utter vulnerability to sudden hunger pangs.
A compulsive gambler blind to everything else in life. Incapable of knowing when to fold, he consistently loses his shirt and survives entirely on short-term consumer credit loans.
A hostess at an upscale cabaret lounge who goes by the stage name 'Reika.' Inspired by a company executive and self-styled street racer she met at work, she took to the Shuto herself.

column3: モスキート レモン
column11: Acts as an informal life counselor, fielding personal dilemmas from young racers. Drivers even travel from neighboring prefectures to seek his advice, though his driving is unremarkable.
The sheltered heiress of a major banking tycoon. Despising an arranged marriage orchestrated by her father, she fled home and now scrapes by on underground wager races.
A lone wolf who refuses to run with a pack, tearing across the asphalt in solitary silence. Once revered as one of the legendary 'Four Devas of the Loop,' he now runs quietly in secluded sectors.
column17: Former member of THE 4 DEVAS (Midnight Silver Wolf)

column11: While his driving is middle-of-the-road, his mechanical fabrication craft is undisputed No. 1 in Kanto. His hobby is pottery; when transporting fresh kiln-fired ceramics, he drives in a foul temper.

column3: キューティー ヒップ
column11: A front-runner specialist who never shows a rival anything other than her rear bumper. In her romantic life as well, she clearly prefers being pursued over doing the chasing.

Raised in the southern islands, he honed his driving tearing through raging typhoons. While he boasts of being unbeatable in storms, expressway closures during severe typhoons keep his true pace a mystery.

column3: 不屈のアレキサンダー
column11: Aiming to conquer the Shuto just as Alexander the Great subjugated territory from Rome to India, he plans to establish his asphalt dominion first through absolute cumulative mileage.
Fascinates onlookers with cornering lines cut as sharply as an architect's set square. His ultimate quest is ensuring the sum of three consecutive cornering angles equals exactly 180 degrees.

column3: ジェット スケーター
column11: A former Olympic speed skater. Applying rigorous trajectory mathematics to the asphalt, he operates in a high-stakes realm where battles are decided by tenths of a second.

column3: 迷走のアイドルフリーク
column11: Purchased a car solely to chase underground idol groups across Japan. The pace he unleashes when running late for a concert is terrifying; he recently spotted a new idol target around the Shuto.
A wildly popular mainstream idol currently enjoying massive fame. Having learned to drive to evade stalking fans and paparazzi, she became intoxicated by speed and took to the highway.
Formerly one of the revered Four Devas, he lost his throne after completely destroying his signature machine. His death-defying, ferocious driving remains fully intact to this day.
The notorious motto 'I only obey rules that bring victory' was born directly from this lawless desperado's reckless, win-at-all-costs highway rampage.
An employee in the cartography department of a professional map publisher. He drives while visually verifying landmarks to ensure his 'Complete Shuto Loop Map' achieves sub-centimeter accuracy.
Tired of the agonizingly long drive home after dropping off his girlfriend, the sheer desperation to get to bed quickly caused him to develop elite speed without ever realizing his talent.
An active, high-profile race queen. After being given a high-speed passenger hot lap by her team's professional racing driver, she became hopelessly addicted to the adrenaline of velocity.
Can diagnose a machine's precise level of internal modification simply by listening to its exhaust note. If a car approaching from the rear sounds dangerously fast, he refuses to engage.
Suffers from sudden, excruciating gout flare-ups in his right foot that prevent him from depressing the throttle, forcing him to maintain fanatical discipline over his daily dietary intake.
Though quite young, severe premature balding causes people to mistake him for a middle-aged man, a sore spot he obsesses over. Fellow racers often joke that he drives like an impulsive kid.

His father is a master arborist. Having grown up surrounded by foliage, as he blasts along the highway he can instantly identify the exact species and coordinates of every tree in his peripheral vision.
Spent fortunes lightening his chassis until realizing that shedding his own excess body fat was vastly more cost-effective. He is currently on a punishing diet with a target of minus 30 kilograms!
Nobody holds a candle to his surgical precision when parking in tight service area bays. On the open highway, however, drivers who can outpace him are a dime a dozen.

column3: ストーキング　ハンマー
column11: Rather than challenging a target directly, he stalks their private life to gather dirt, aiming to drain their psychological Spirit Points to zero before the green light even flashes—the lowest scum on the road.
Enjoys entering major city marathons as an amateur runner. His habit of sprinting the first 300 meters purely to get onto the live television broadcast carries over directly into his racing launches.
Dominates opponents with an aggressive, full-throttle American-style driving technique. Across the entire Shuto Expressway, nobody has ever witnessed her suffer defeat.
The lone survivor still running the asphalt after his former squad disbanded. Now carrying the team's moniker as his personal handle, his double life as daytime salesman and midnight racer continues.
column17: Former SPEED BOX member; keeps the legacy alive

column11: Has reigned over these roads for more than a decade, racking up over a thousand street duels. An endless parade of challengers rise to test him, only to fall one after another...

column3: ゴールド　ライセンス
column11: An exemplary, law-abiding driver who disdains reckless maneuvers. Blessed with immaculate heel-and-toe shifting craft, his battle win rate is remarkably solid.

column3: アイアン　レーサー
column11: President of Suzuyama Mold Industry Co. His iron will and stoic work ethic inspire deep awe and veneration not only among his company employees, but throughout the street racing underground.

column3: キング　オブ　エデン
column11: General manager of 'Anrakuen,' a traditional hot-spring ryokan in Hakone. Faced with declining tourism, he drives all the way to Daikoku PA to drum up business between high-speed runs.
Ranks among the top one or two fastest drivers in Tokyo, yet remains remarkably selfless and unburdened by ego. He eschews destructive peak tunes in favor of keeping his machine healthy forever.

column3: ジェントル　レイン
column11: His car has pushed past nearly thirty years of service; to prevent torrential rainwater from leaking through severe cracks in the weathered roof, he keeps an umbrella handy in the cockpit at all times.

column3: サイレント　バーバリアン
column11: Stalks quietly on an opponent's bumper before executing a sudden, devastating pass. Pursuing racers swear that all they have ever seen of him is his retreating tail lights.
